notes.title: The worker apologizes! （Open cheat code）
notes.notes:
1: Player saves disappear due to cloud saving
2: To make up for player losses, open the game cheat code



1: Players enter the game (initial state), play the game (do not finish, only need to pass the first level, then sell traps and wait for the end of the game)
2: After the online mode is enabled on the initial screen, select the online mode and enter --[b] xhfx147369[/b] in the password setting field
3: After entering the cheat code，then in the Join room, click the room refresh button!


Tip: This cheat code can only be used when the player is level 0!
